Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_no_of_bags number;
 temp_red_tube_flag VARCHAR2(10);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 default_value('','GLOBAL.bag_code');
 reconcile_bags(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,temp_no_of_bags,
 :GLOBAL.bag_code);
 check_package_failure;
 if :GLOBAL.bag_code is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0039');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_no_of_bags < 1
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id := ' ' ;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 show_error('0134');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_v_comp_prefix varchar2(2);
 temp_v_sld varchar2(2);
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 savepoint all_clear;

 begin
 SELECT nvl(max(to_number(component_prefix)),0) + 1
 INTO temp_v_comp_prefix
 FROM components 
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_id 
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) 
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 AND product_code = 'NONE';
 exception
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;



 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 -- temp_v_comp_prefix := '00';
 temp_v_sld := 'Md';
 ELSE
 temp_v_sld := '47'; 
 END IF;
 begin
 insert into components
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, insert_dats,
 component_prefix, product_code, bag_id, component_status,
 reject_reason_code, system_label_decision, label_Dats, 
 label_user_id, program_id)
 values
 (:unit_id, :coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, sysdate,
 temp_v_comp_prefix,'NONE', :catalog_number,
 'L', :reject_reason_code, temp_v_sld, sysdate,
 :banner.user_id, :banner.prog_name );
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if not form_success
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 down;
 end if;
end;
